svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: DPEG — Acquisition Module · Entity Relationship Diagram
Every object in the acquisition lifecycle: broker intake → lead conversion → deal negotiation & due diligence → transaction handoff. Relationships only; fields omitted.
the set is the version history
Column = dependency rank, parent to the left
No Master-Detail exists anywhere in this graph —
every relationship is a Lookup, so nothing cascade-deletes.
one A ⟶ many B (1 : N Lookup; B holds the lookup field to A)
Not a lookup — lead conversion, or a plain Text pointer
Lead conversion — the spine of the acquisition lifecycle
Not drawn as edges: Opportunity's four reverse "primary" pointers (Primary_LOI__c, Primary_Underwriting__c, Primary_Contract__c,
Primary_NDA__c — each 1 : 1, naming the current record), the Opportunity self-lookup Portfolio_Deal__c, and role lookups to User.
